name: Force Earnings Sync on a Reinstating POST
description: FLP-2033 (reinstatement edge case). SLD POSTs a draft apprenticeship and Commitments approves it, which releases its earnings to Payments. SLD then DELETEs it, which releases again so Payments clears them. With every episode removed the learner drops out of SLD's GET, so the next submission is a POST, not a PUT. Support sets ForceEarningsSync and SLD POSTs the learner again: Learning reinstates the learning and reports Reinstated plus ForceEarningsSync, and the outer API releases all earnings after the reinstatement's on-programme update. The release needs the learner key, which now comes from Learning's POST response. Support then clears the flag. Expect three on-programme releases: approval, removal and the forced reinstatement. Without the force, a reinstating POST releases nothing, leaving Payments with no earnings. Needs the ForceEarningsSync column in the local Learning DB. Bus messages are asserted from EventHub's ReceivedEvents, so EventHub must be running locally.

steps.name: Removal released again so Payments clears the earnings
SLD Reinstates the Apprenticeship (all earnings released)

assertions.name: Learning episode is reinstated and still approved
The reinstating POST is recorded with both Reinstated and ForceEarningsSync
On-programme earnings are released three times: approval, removal and the forced reinstatement
Every release carries the learner key
